🎥🎬: Family Guy (1999–present)

The Griffin family lives in Quahog, Rhode Island, where their everyday lives are filled with outrageous adventures, strange situations, and unpredictable comedy. Peter Griffin, a loud and impulsive father, often creates chaos for his wife Lois, their children Meg, Chris, and Stewie, and their talking dog Brian.

As the family navigates relationships, work, and life’s challenges, they encounter everything from bizarre inventions and wild schemes to unexpected adventures beyond their hometown. With its sharp satire, pop culture jokes, and unique characters, Family Guy has become one of the most recognizable animated comedies in television history.

source_details.synopsis: Family Guy is an American animated sitcom created by Seth MacFarlane for the Fox Broadcasting Company. The series premiered on January 31, 1999, following Super Bowl XXXIII, with the rest of the first season airing from April 11, 1999. The show centers around the Griffins, a dysfunctional family consisting of parents Peter and Lois, their children, Meg, Chris, and Stewie, and their anthropomorphic pet dog, Brian. Set in the fictional city of Quahog, Rhode Island, the show exhibits much of its humor in the form of cutaway gags that often lampoon American culture.
